content.text: people loveeeee to hate on her 😭 but I love her she’s so real ♥️I’m actually excited to watch this season! 😭Can someone please explain why she is going to be so exciting to watch?The last photo is not the @bacheloretteabc I loved since Tristas season. Finding her Ryan,and 20 years later still in love! This girl is drama,no man will be what she wants,a instant dad to multiple kids is one thing,but having to move to Utah is another. I want it where you choose from the contestants who had their hearts broken for the @bacheloretteabc and @bachelorabc ,even @goldenbachabc ! Mel was a nice surprise with Peg though! But moving forward please give the ones who weren't chosen a chance to find love!The last photo completely sums up why I won’t be watching this season. This show used to be about finding the one. It has never been “wholesome” but at least it had a genuine purpose. Now it is just like all reality TV which promotes the biggest dumpster fire 🔥 imaginable and does so only for ratings. ABC stopped caring a long time ago and that was evident with Jenn’s season and this season was the last straw for me and all the women I know who have been viewers since the beginning.I wonder if the birds will remain or will be blurred out 😂wtf is up w her finger in the last slide? Tryna look cool flipping the bird with bad editing 😂 fingers don’t look like that.I HATE they PICKED her of alll people to be the bachelorette… I’m not even interested in watching it nowI thought this was about finding love not another baby daddy. This gal needs to get in line, surely they could have found another actual real viable option for the next Bachelorette that wasn’t a shit show. Are dudes actually signing up for this? People can’t be this desperate for a date or to be famous…Shit show. I’ll watch and hope it’s good but she really doesn’t meet the profile of a bachelorette. I thought people with a record couldn’t participate…The death rattle of Bach franchise.
